title: Why FMD, and when not to use it
description: A data platform that hand-builds one pipeline per source table is buying a linear cost curve. FMD is a metadata-driven ingestion framework for Microsoft Fabric that flattens it: you describe a table as rows in a configuration database, and a fixed set of pipelines and notebooks lands it, historises it and audits it.
